consent.title: Consent to process health data
consent.intro: Health data (e.g. pain, medications, blood tests, body composition) is a special category of personal data under GDPR (Art. 9). We need your explicit, separate consent.
points: Data is stored in the EU (Frankfurt) and encrypted.
It is used only to personalise your plans.
The AI coach receives only the minimum needed; your data is never used to train models.
You can export your data or delete your account at any time in Settings.
consent.health: I explicitly consent to the processing of my health data to personalise plans in the app.
consent.terms: I agree to the terms of use and acknowledge the privacy policy.
consent.required: Without consent to process health data we can't personalise plans. You can withdraw consent at any time.
consent.notMedical: This app is for education and wellness. It does not diagnose, prescribe or replace a doctor.

supp.forProfileNote: General suggestions from your diet and the season, not medical advice. If you are ill or on medication, ask your doctor.
supp.whyB12Vegan: Vitamin B12 is the one nutrient a vegan diet cannot supply without fortified foods. A supplement is needed.
supp.whyB12Vegetarian: Milk and eggs provide little of it; B12 deficiency is common in vegetarians.
supp.whyIodineVegan: Without dairy and fish, iodised salt is the main iodine source. Without it, intake is often low.
supp.whyOmega3NoFish: Without fish, long-chain omega-3 (EPA and DHA) is missing. Plant ALA converts poorly; an algae supplement exists.
supp.whyVitDWinter: From October to March the skin makes almost no vitamin D at Central European latitudes.

mob.title: Mobility & pain
mob.scoreQ: How bad is the pain right now? (0 = none, 10 = worst imaginable)
mob.flagsIntro: Please answer these questions. If any applies, we won't suggest exercises.
mob.emergencyTitle: Call emergency services (112) or go to A&E
mob.emergencyText: These symptoms can signal a condition that needs urgent assessment. Don't try exercises now.
mob.doctorText: A doctor should assess these symptoms before you start exercises. Book as soon as possible — if things get worse, call 112.
mob.qDesk: Do you mostly work sitting down?
mob.qLoad: Has your training load changed recently?
mob.notDiagnosis: Not a diagnosis — just common contributing factors.
mob.stageRule: Progress: pain during exercise ≤ 3/10 and not worse next day → next stage. 4–5/10 → stay. Above 5/10 or worse next day → step back a stage.

flags.saddle_numbness: Numbness around the genitals, buttocks or inner thighs
flags.bladder_bowel: New trouble passing urine, or loss of bladder or bowel control
flags.progressive_weakness: Weakness that is getting worse (e.g. foot drop, dropping things)
flags.spreading_numbness: Spreading numbness or tingling, or in both arms/legs
flags.major_trauma: Pain started after significant trauma (fall from height, car accident, heavy impact)
flags.fever_or_weight_loss: Fever, chills, unexplained weight loss or a history of cancer
flags.night_pain: Severe night pain not eased by any position
flags.chest_pain: Chest pain or pressure, pain into the jaw or left arm, shortness of breath
flags.deformity_or_unable_to_bear_weight: Visible deformity or you can't put weight on the limb
flags.hot_swollen_joint: A red, hot, swollen joint, possibly with fever
flags.calf_swelling: One calf is swollen, warm and tender (especially after long sitting, travel or surgery)

looks.safety: No mewing, bone-smashing, extreme cutting or sunbeds. If worries about your looks affect your day, talk to a professional.

progress.title: Progress
progress.intro: How your volume and strength grow. Only working sets count, not warm-ups. Strength is an estimated one-rep max (e1RM) from your sets.

progress.emptyStrength: The strength chart appears once you log a set with weight.

weight.title: Weight & measurements
weight.intro: Log your weight, ideally in the morning after waking up. It swings 1–2 kg day to day with water and food, so we track the 7-day trend — that shows the real direction.
weight.logHint: Fill in only what you have. A second entry on the same day replaces the first.
weight.invalid: Check the numbers — fill in at least one value in a sensible range.
weight.chartHint: Dots are single weigh-ins, the line is the 7-day average.
weight.empty: No weigh-ins yet. Log your first value and the chart starts filling in.
weight.emptyRange: No weigh-ins in this period. Try a longer one.
weight.waistHint: Waist is a good marker of belly fat — it often changes even when weight stalls.
weight.note: Weight is just one number. While building muscle it can stay flat or rise even as fat goes down. Losing fast (more than ~1% of body weight a week) costs more muscle. If tracking weight stresses you, feel free to skip it.
weight.bodyLinkHint: Log a weigh-in and follow the trend

billing.q1: Can I cancel Pro any time?
billing.a1: Yes. Once payments launch, you will cancel in Settings and Pro stays on until the end of the paid period. Nothing is charged during the beta.
billing.q2: What happens to my data if I go back to free?
billing.a2: Nothing is deleted. All entries, photos and results stay; only the Pro tools lock until you turn Pro back on.
billing.a3: Payments are still being prepared. They will go through a secure payment gateway (card, and possibly Apple Pay and Google Pay), and we will not store card details ourselves.
billing.a4: The prices shown are final — nothing is added on top.
billing.a5: The education site, guides and logging stay free. Pro pays for running the AI and further development — so we don’t have to fill the site with ads or sell data.
billing.q6: Does BLWB replace a doctor or coach?
billing.a6: No. It helps you understand your body and track what you do. Diagnosis and treatment belong with a doctor; with blood results we always flag when it is worth asking one.
billing.q7: What if Pro isn’t useful to me?
billing.a7: During the beta you can try it for free. Once payments start, you can cancel anytime and the next period won’t be charged.
